rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete and extensive drafting template. Both directives distribute priorities or allocation authority among Interior for fuels, Agriculture for food or agricultural commodities, transportation officials for transportation facilities, and Commerce for the residual category. The child also closely reproduces C06's detailed definition of agricultural commodities as its definition of “food,” and adapts C06's voluntary-agreement machinery, including consultation with and approval by the Attorney General. C22 is a secondary influence on the child's real-estate-credit provisions, especially coordinated housing-credit restrictions preserving veterans' preferences, but is materially narrower. C11 shares delegation and subpoena machinery but lacks C06's distinctive sector-by-sector architecture.

shared_material.child_excerpt: To the Secretary of the Interior with respect to petroleum, gas, solid fuels, and electric power... To the Secretary of Agriculture with respect to food... [to the ICC commissioner] with respect to domestic transportation... To the Secretary of Commerce with respect to all materials and facilities except as provided...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The authority... is delegated severally to the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of Commerce, and the Director of the Office of Defense Transportation... Interior... fuels... Agriculture... agricultural commodities... transportation facilities and equipment... Commerce... scarce commodities... other than fuels... agricultural commodities... and transportation facilities and equipment.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the parent's distinctive four-part allocation of economic-control authority by commodity or facility sector, while updating the responsible transportation official and statutory basis.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The term “food” shall mean all commodities and products, simple, mixed, or compound, or complements to such commodities or products, that are capable of being eaten or drunk by either human beings or animals, irrespective of other uses... at all stages of processing from the raw commodity to the products thereof in vendible form... [and] all starches, sugars, vegetable and animal fats and oils, cotton, tobacco, wool... hemp, flax fiber...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The term “agricultural commodities” means all commodities and products, simple, mixed, or compound, or complements to such commodities or products that are or may be eaten or drunk by human beings or animals, irrespective of other uses... at all stages of processing from the raw commodity to the product thereof in a vendible form... [and] all starches, sugars, fats and oils... cotton, tobacco, wool, hemp, flax fiber...
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, substantially verbatim definitional language, adapted principally by renaming the defined category and making limited changes to its included products.

shared_material.child_excerpt: each delegate concerned shall consult with the Attorney General and the Chairman of the Federal Trade Commission not less than ten days before making any request or finding... [and] obtain the approval of the Attorney General to any request
shared_material.parent_excerpt: no such agreement or plan shall be approved... unless it is first submitted to and approved by the Attorney General... Prior to submitting any such proposed agreement or plan to the Attorney General...
shared_material.explanation: The child's voluntary-agreement provisions preserve and elaborate the parent's Attorney General consultation-and-approval machinery.
